name: Outland Slaver lowers Felrend and Fel Fireball cost and raises their damage (#809)
contract: Outland Slaver 705123 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (misc=14, SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectBasePoints=-4, DieSides=1 (real -3), and effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (misc=0, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) with EffectBasePoints=9, DieSides=1 (real +10%). Both share a classmask (family 20, dword1 bits 0+2) matching Fel Fireball (e.g. 801312) and Felrend (e.g. 800210) by SpellFamilyFlags. SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone apply SPELLMOD_COST/SPELLMOD_DAMAGE generically, so both spells' cost drops by 3 and damage rises by 10%.
